mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal function and electrolyte balance; dorzolamide inhibits carbonic anhydrase leading to metabolic acidosis and altered electrolytes, while valganciclovir is nephrotoxic and renally cleared, creating additive risk of renal impairment and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR), electrolytes (particularly potassium and bicarbonate), and acid-base status regularly during concurrent use; adjust valganciclovir dosing based on renal function.
